name: DrisBlueSeventeen
description: Driscoll's blueberry cultivar, trade name Carlotta. Distinctive because its official description comes from a CPVO technical examination carried out by an independent body in Portugal over four seasons, which describes the fruit as soft. Parentage '136D 2' x '8B 4', crossed 2004 in Santa Cruz County, California and selected in 2006.

attributes.rights: Canada plant breeders' rights certificate 7097, granted 3 May 2024
